Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/warriors/snake.red:
     1	;redcode-94
     2	;name Snake
     3	;author Wayne Sheppard
     4	;source https://corewar.co.uk/snake.htm
     5	;strategy Pitbomber-impspiral
     6	;assert CORESIZE == 8000 && MAXCYCLES == 80000
     7	
     8	;Dan only plays bombers and imps on the hill.  But I am hoping
     9	;that he will go with a paper or scanner
    10	
    11	;Snake is a vampire and imp
    12	;Night Crawler would lose vs paper
    13	;The vampire should gain enough wins to beat paper
    14	;Should still have a winning record vs scanners
    15	;Probably lose vs other imps
    16	
    17	dist    equ 121             ; Bomb spread distance
    18	imp     equ icopy+1800      ; Imp start location  
    19	hide    equ 1600            ; Vampire hide location
    20	
    21	; Trap and pit for vampire victims
    22	trap    jmp pit-x-121+2, x+121   ; Trap statement in front to foil tracers
    23	x       spl 0,           trap
    24	        mov @0,          @trap
    25	        sub 4,           @-1
    26	        jmp -2
    27	pit     mov @dist,       <0-dist
    28	        spl 0                     ; This should change more losses into ties
    29	        spl -1                    ; than wins into ties
    30	
    31	; Massive decoy field - 63 lines to slow down enemy djn scans
    32	        dat     <trap,          <1      ; decoys
    33	        dat     <trap,          <1      ; slow down enemy djn  
    34	        dat     <trap,          <1      ; but don't cmp equal

    95	
    96	; Main execution - vampire setup and binary ring launcher  
    97	start   mov     trap+4,         hide            ; Copy vampire components
    98	        mov     trap+3,         <start          ; to safe hide location
    99	        mov     trap+2,         <start          
   100	        mov     trap+1,         <start
   101	        mov     trap,           <start
   102	        mov     pit+2,          hide
   103	        mov     pit+1,          <-1
   104	        mov     pit,            <-2
   105	        spl     start+hide-3,   <1              ; 1st split to vampire
   106	
   107	; Binary ring imp launcher - creates multiple imp streams
   108	ring    spl     9,              <4050           ; Binary tree startup
   109	        spl     5,              <4100           
   110	        spl     3,              <4150
   111	        mov     icopy,          imp             ; Copy imp template away from decoys
   112	        jmp     start+hide-3,   <4200           ; 2nd split to vampire
   113	        jmp     imp,            <4250           ; Launch first imp stream
   114	        spl     2,              <4300
   115	        jmp     2667+imp,       <6350           ; Imp stream at 2667 interval
   116	        jmp     5334+imp,       <4400           ; Imp stream at 5334 interval  
   117	        spl     4,              <4450
   118	        spl     2,              <4500
   119	        jmp     1+imp,          <4550           ; Imp stream at +1 offset
   120	        jmp     2668+imp,       <4600           ; Imp stream at 2668 interval
   121	        spl     2,              <4650
   122	        jmp     5335+imp,       <4700           ; Imp stream at 5335 interval
   123	        jmp     2+imp,          <4750           ; Imp stream at +2 offset
   124	
   125	; Imp template
   126	icopy   mov     0,              2667            ; Basic imp: mov 0, 2667
   127	
   128	        end     start
